title: You were born with 300 bones. Now you have 206 🦴 #shorts
description:
Babies are born with about 270–300 bones; many fuse as we grow, leaving adults with 206. More than half — 106 — are in the hands and feet (27 per hand, 26 per foot).
Sources: Cleveland Clinic 'Skeletal System'; Encyclopaedia Britannica 'Human skeleton'.

Inner Numbers — your body, counted. New Short every day.
Educational content, not medical advice.

scenes.say: You were born with around three hundred bones.
Today, you have two hundred and six.
They didn't disappear. Many of them fused together as you grew.
And every bone is built in layers.
More than half of all your bones are in your hands and feet.
Look at your hands. Fifty four bones. Follow for more of your body, counted.
